title: dalbergia amerimnum
intro: Dalbergia amerimnum, commonly known as Palisandro or Amarillo, is a tropical plant belonging to the family Fabaceae. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and it has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Dalbergia amerimnum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against infections and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which may exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
